classification.source_level_rationale: Produced contemporaneously by Swiss television as a direct report on the Greek election campaign and political events.
classification.resume: This Swiss TV news report from November 1974 covers the Greek parliamentary election campaign, juxtaposing scenes of political rallies, candidate appearances, and everyday life across Athens, Patras, Kea, and Yaros. It features interviews with politicians including Konstantinos Karamanlis and Alexandros Panagoulis, alongside footage of ex-regime figures and island deportations.
